output.summary: An onion relative native to southern Europe, southwestern Asia and North Africa, wild leek produces a round flower stalk topped by many white, pink or red flowers. Cultivated forms include leek, elephant garlic, pearl onion, kurrat and Persian leek; kurrat and Persian leek leaves are eaten.
output.edibilityNote: Cultivated forms are vegetables; kurrat is grown mainly for edible leaves, while Persian leek leaves are eaten raw alone or with other foods.
